dedupe_keys.name: brunei darussalam department of economic planning and statistics 2021 population and housing census report with occupied housing units by district and kampung and housing amenities water supply prepaid or metered electricity toilet type garbage disposal insurance internet

description: Brunei's Department of Economic Planning and Statistics published the report of the 2021 Population and Housing Census as a 94 page bilingual PDF. It counts 83,810 occupied housing units and 87,137 households, 59,472 of the units in Brunei Muara District, and traces housing units back to 1971. A housing amenities section covers water supply, the source of electricity, toilet facilities, garbage disposal and housing insurance: 99.7 percent of occupied units had electricity, 77,135 of them on prepaid meters and 6,419 on conventional meters, with 214 using generators. Household items include air conditioners and internet access at home. Housing units are also listed by kampung (village), the smallest census area. Coverage is national. Format and access: free PDF, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: most amenity results are given nationally or by district inside the text and charts, not as downloadable tables. Simulation uses: prepaid versus metered electricity and district housing counts for load and demand planning, and kampung housing counts for exposure to floods. Related records: none for Brunei in the catalogue.
